description: A report script for POS Register in ERPNext, handling POS invoice data retrieval, grouping, and filtering.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate POS register report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_pos_entries
methods.description: Fetches POS invoice entries from the database with optional grouping.

methods.name: concat_mode_of_payments
methods.description: Concatenates multiple payment modes for each POS invoice entry.

methods.name: add_subtotal_row
methods.description: Adds subtotal row for grouped data.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the input filters for the report.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_group_by_field
methods.description: Determines the database field to group by based on user selection.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report output.
